title: Help page af/help-topic@1
$comment: What `af help TOPIC --json` and `af help errors CAUSE --json` print when the words name no command but a page `af help` prints as text (ADR-0258): the page's name, its one-line description and its text, rendered by the same function as the text form. Words that name a command print af/command-catalog@1 instead.

name.description: The words after `af help` that name the page: a topic (`agents`), or `errors CAUSE`.

description.description: The one-line description the text form's title line `af help NAME — DESCRIPTION` carries, as `af help` lists it; null for `af help errors CAUSE`, whose text form has no title line.

text.description: The page exactly as `af help NAME` prints it: below its title line and the blank line after it (all of it when it has no title line), without the final newline.
